review_type: source-locked qualitative identity anchor spot check
reviewer: Codex AI visual review; not human-consensus identity ground truth

method.candidate_rule: IoU >= 0.20 OR (prediction center inside the source anchor AND IoU >= 0.10)
method.ranking: descending IoU, then confidence; all qualified candidates retained
method.unique_assignment_rule: exactly one qualified candidate and a non-null track ID at each anchor
method.multiple_candidate_rule: flag ambiguous_multiple_candidates; do not infer which candidate is the person automatically
method.no_id_rule: candidate with null track_id is detected_but_unassigned, not a tracked person
method.comparison: compare IDs only within the same clip/run/repeat; matching numbers across runs have no meaning
method.frames: only pre-locked before/after frame, no best-looking frame substitution

scope: Rep01 only; 14 clip/run files, 21 episode comparisons, 42 anchor observations. Three source episodes, not 21 independent videos.

limitations: Source same-person association is likely, not proven through full occlusion/offscreen absence.
Manual anchor boxes are approximate regions. Spatial overlap is a proxy and not verified detection/identity ground truth.
Same IDs at two anchors do not prove uninterrupted correct identity between them.
Changed IDs after full absence can be expected when absence exceeds the configured 24-frame lost buffer; this is not a claim of tracker malfunction.
No HOTA, IDF1, MOTA or detection recall; no model-wide identity-accuracy ranking from three episodes.
All tracker comparisons have ReID off, GMC none; association thresholds retain their native differences.
Crossing clip excluded: no locked source identity anchor boxes.

supplementary_counting_failure.repeat_scope: All three summaries checked; detailed box/ID evidence is rep01.
supplementary_counting_failure.supporting_candidate_rule: For F0..138, IoU >= .30 with the source-visually-associated ByteTrack ID4 box and bottom-y difference <=8 px; this is a post-hoc spatial trace proxy, not full identity ground truth.
supplementary_counting_failure.direct_mechanism: The target foot-bearing detections never obtain a TrackTrack ID around the crossing. Only non-null IDs are passed to the shared counter; therefore it has no target trajectory to count. This is not a max-gap reset of an established target counter track.
supplementary_counting_failure.threshold_explanation: All supporting target detections before and through the source event have score < .7, so the pinned TrackTrack new-track rule rejects them. Scores above its .6 high threshold alone do not establish a new ID. No threshold ablation was run.
supplementary_counting_failure.box_quality_caveat: At F135 the ByteTrack-ID4 box spans the leading gray person and the blue person behind. A separate tighter gray-person box is also present, without ID. Bottom-coordinate agreement is not proof of correct full-person detection or identity.
supplementary_counting_failure.visual_status: Visually checked source and all three tracker rows at F113/F125/F135; the shared box includes gray foreground and blue background people, and its bottom follows the gray person.

code_references.observation: Only non-null IDs are inserted into counter points

supplementary_counting_failure.conclusion: Distinct IDs 12 -> 5 does not establish improvement: this TrackTrack configuration also loses one source-confirmed counting event.
supplementary_counting_failure.evidence_location: Lower panel: missed source event S01
